examShortTricks: Trick 1: Thesis: humanity survives because research keeps solving new threats — science as insurance; state the thesis in one line.
Trick 2: The seismologist's examples: earthquake prediction, medicine, energy — pick two of his examples to show 'research = survival'.
Trick 3: Funding argument: basic research looks useless today but pays off tomorrow — the delayed-return logic is the essay's hardest point; explain it with one example.
practiceQuestions: Q. Why does the writer call research a token of survival? (2 marks) — every human crisis has been answered by scientific research; future threats need it too.
Q. Why should society fund 'useless' basic research? (2 marks) — today's curiosity becomes tomorrow's cure; give one example (e.g. earthquake studies).
keyPoints: Research is humankind's survival tool — curiosity now prevents catastrophe later.
Argument structure: small findings accumulate into civilisational protection.
